answer: Proof-of-space commitment resists sybils: each identity must commit a large block of disk and periodically prove the committed plot is intact, so participation scales with real storage, not account count. A vertex of fakes cannot share one plot — the commitment binds a distinct plot per identity, and a farm cannot reach the zenith of influence without genuinely dedicating storage across the canyon of its accounts. Honest agents commit one plot; a thousand fakes need a thousand real plots, a physical cost that does not collapse.
